fix_instructions: The scenario is currently too difficult or the public facts are too strong, leading models to stick to the default/draft values. To make the hidden information necessary, ensure that the public facts (S1-S4) do not implicitly suggest the correct answers. For example, if S1-S4 imply Ms. Lee is available for period 4, the model will never trigger C3. Tighten the dependency of C3 on PF1 by ensuring the public facts create a conflict that only PF1 can resolve.
